principle: Off-watch time includes both genuine leisure and mandatory obligations. These obligations consume schedule time and can reduce available rest/recreation if overused.
scheduling_rules: Mandatory obligations cannot consume protected biological rest below the active fatigue/safety policy without an explicit exception.
Department heads and senior officers may have administrative time outside station watch.
On-call is an availability constraint, not continuous physical presence at a duty station.
Training and drills may be cancelled or preempted by mission/emergency state.
Repeated double shifts create fatigue debt and readiness consequences.
An officer who is off watch can still be unavailable because of sleep, medical care, training or private commitments.
The player initiating dialogue does not cancel an NPC obligation.
species_rule: Rest/sleep needs come from character biology/medical state where available; do not impose one Human sleep requirement on all species.
ai_boundary: AI may explain why an NPC is unavailable; it cannot cancel or invent obligations.
